SMS Terms of Service

Reservation messaging program · Effective November 19, 2026

This program is operated by Seafood Huntsville 888 LLC, doing business as The Juicy Seafood & Bar, at 4925 University Drive NW, Suite B, Huntsville, AL 35816.

What you are signing up for

If you choose to receive reservation texts, we will use the mobile number you provide to send automated messages about your restaurant reservation. These include reservation reminders, requests to confirm your visit, arrival check-in instructions, and acknowledgments of your replies. This program does not include promotional or marketing messages.

A reminder approximately one hour before your reservation asks you to reply CONFIRM. A reminder approximately ten minutes before your reservation asks you to reply HERE only once your whole party has arrived. An arrival acknowledgment does not guarantee that a table is ready; please check in with the host.

Your choice and consent

To join, enter your mobile number on our reservation form, actively select the optional SMS consent checkbox, and submit your reservation. The checkbox is unchecked by default. Consent is not required to make a reservation or purchase. Enter a number you own or are authorized to use.

Message frequency and rates

Message frequency varies with your reservation and replies: up to four automated texts per visit, plus replies. Message and data rates may apply. Your mobile carrier's messaging and data charges apply according to your plan.

Stop messages or get help

Reply STOP to any program text to opt out. You may receive a final message confirming your opt-out. Stopping SMS does not cancel your restaurant reservation.

Reply HELP for help, or call our restaurant at (256) 964-8975. Contact the host team to change or cancel a reservation. The program's toll-free messaging number is +1 (855) 700-4925.

Delivery and privacy

Message delivery depends on mobile network availability and may be delayed. Wireless carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

Read our Privacy Policy for how we handle reservation information, mobile numbers, and SMS consent.
